crossRefs.note: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are…
then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because…

translations.web: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
translations.bsb: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her, he must pay the full dowry for her to be his wife.
translations.kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
translations.asv: And if a man entice a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
